title: Review queue architecture readiness check (report-only CI rollout)
intent: Implement the valid question behind TD-2 without its historical architecture. The repository can now answer whether the declared operational prerequisites of the review-queue subsystem are present, derived deterministically from repository evidence rather than asserted by a caller. Replaces the historical POST /readiness endpoint and in-memory assessment registry, which are deliberately NOT carried forward. Requirement set ratified by owner ruling from the historical 8F assessment; structural precedent is CAM 7J.
behavior_change: Adds a CLI and a report-only CI step. No runtime route is added. No production behaviour changes: the evaluator is read-only, mutates nothing, and executes no workflow. The CI step runs inside the existing Fence Checks (Blocking) job with --report-only, so known readiness gaps do NOT fail the sole required check during rollout; an evaluator error still fails. Report content is truthful (currently NOT_READY) - only enforcement is deferred, and severities were not weakened to obtain a green check.

diff_articulation.what_changed: Four new modules under services/api/app/cam (contracts, ratified requirements, pure evaluator, evidence adapter), one CLI under scripts/ci, a report-only step added to the existing Fence Checks (Blocking) job, five test modules, and subsystem documentation.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: main has no architecture-readiness evaluator. review_queue_ci.py assesses queue CONTENTS (item counts, blocking issues); this assesses subsystem ARCHITECTURE (persistence, identity, timestamps, notification). CAM 7J assesses governance EVIDENCE readiness. The three subjects are distinct and the documentation states the separation explicitly to prevent future conflation.

commands_run: pytest tests/cam/ -k 'review_queue and not readiness' -> 62 passed (no regression in existing review-queue tests)
CLI enforcement mode -> exit 1 (NOT_READY, truthful: 3 of 4 ratified requirements unmet)
CLI --report-only -> exit 0 with NOT_READY still printed
JSON output byte-identical across consecutive runs (determinism)
architecture_scan.yml still contains zero 'paths:' filters; required check name unchanged
verification.known_residual: The check is REPORT-ONLY and does not gate merges. Promotion to enforcement requires a separate owner ruling. RQR-002-IDENTITY evaluates UNRESOLVED_RUNTIME_VALIDATION_REQUIRED by design: a reviewer_ref declaration is visible statically, but whether authentication is enforced on the request path is a runtime property this check cannot and does not claim to settle.
